vram_model: RGBA8 with full mip chain = w*h*4*4/3 bytes (uncompressed); VRAM-compressed (BC7/DXT) estimated at 1/4. Textures shared between assets are counted once in the folder total and in full for each asset that uses them.

textures_collected_from_source_handoffs.note: tools/collect_textures.sh re-copies every texture from city_road_kit / city_atm / city_bank into a scratch dir; compared byte for byte with textures/ (no texture is generated in this folder)

fully_dressed_as_in_previews.note: the 16 m rear run as in the previews: 4 x bay_4m (x -8..8), 5 x pile_dressing_28 + 1 x pile_dressing_35, 2 shelf units, 2 barrel stacks, 2 crab-pot sets, 8 hung lanterns, 2 hung rowboats, 3 dock ladders (the east run of 2 x bay_3p25 is not counted)

doc_budget.source: no per-prop budget in the docs for the undercroft; own ceiling for the dressed 16 m run: 120k LOD0 / 30k LOD1 (mid-high poly, mostly instanced repeats)

store_totals.note: Draw estimate = (mesh node x material) pairs per LOD, shadows excluded, no instancing. Repeated props are MultiMesh-able.

texture_vram_city_wide.note: same model as the other hand-offs; shared sets counted once; the held cuts (pavers / brick / asphalt) are NOT applied; Gamer imports with VRAM compression

day_night.rule: Every material reads in full daylight. The only emissive surface is the lamp glass of `lantern_hung` (SS_LampGlass: flat warm `#ffc174`, the repo's lantern glow colour, emission energy 0.65): it ships lit; scale `emission_energy_multiplier` down by day (the previews use 0.2 by day, 1.6 at dusk). The assets contain no light nodes: put a warm OmniLight3D (previews: 2.6 energy, 7.5 m, `#ffb366`) at every `mk_light` marker of each lantern at dusk.
day_night.night_renders: previews/*dusk* use preview-only lights; the assets contain no lights, only mk_light_* markers.
